title: Asian stocks rally as Huang's Nvidia return revives AI trade - The Economic Times
text:
Asian shares saw significant gains as Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang made a return that relieved market fears. The MSCI Asia-Pacific index rose by 4.6%, while Japan's Nikkei gained 4.5% after a local holiday. This movement followed a 31.5% surge in Nvidia shares, revealing optimism in the beleaguered AI sector. United States Treasury yields climbed alongside the dollar, signaling increased confidence in Fed tightening measures.
